note: Triennial election of the county council, 1949: nominations 17 May 1949; the only contest was Armagh City, polled 2 June 1949. The Armagh Guardian lists give no party labels, so none are given for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed. Twyble is a new member; M'Nabb is listed among the old members. Dinah M'Nabb: no party label printed in 1949. At other elections he stood as Unionist (North Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 14 June 1945, listed as Unionist; North Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 10 February 1949, listed as Unionist; North Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 22 October 1953, listed as Unionist). Joseph Twyble: no party label printed in 1949. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Portadown (councillors), Portadown Borough, 25 September 1947, printed 'official Unionist': Portadown News, 13 September 1947, p. 6 ("Borough Election: Contest ... Mr. W. Wright Opposes Unionist Nominees"); Portadown (councillors), Portadown Borough, 18 May 1949, printed 'Portadown Unionist Association': Portadown News, 7 May 1949, p. 5 ("No Election in Portadown: Twelve Unionists Returned Unopposed"); names also in the councillors' notice of thanks, Portadown News, 14 May 1949, p. 1; Lurgan (aldermen), Lurgan Borough, 15 June 1949, printed 'U': Portadown News, 18 June 1949, p. 6 ("Unionists' Great Triumph: Election in Lurgan"); nominations in the Lurgan Mail, 4 June 1949, p. 5, and the Portadown News, 11 June 1949, p. 3).
